acceptance_check.expected: for total_records=6, page_size=25, current_page=1: only page 1 available and next disabled

remediation_actions.acceptance_criteria: Pagination QA verifies 6 total records with page size 25 exposes only page 1 with next disabled, and later pages appear automatically only when derived page_count increases.
remediation_actions.decision: Set pagination state from current total_records, page_size and current_page so unavailable phantom pages are not exposed.
remediation_actions.evidence_anchor: Frozen state shows 6 cargas encontradas and page size 25 while pagination exposes pages 1, 2, 3 plus next.
remediation_actions.implementation_change: Set pagination available pages from max(1, ceil(total_records / page_size)) and disable next when current_page equals page_count.

semantic_authority.claim_boundary: Authorizes only state-derived pagination from observed total records, page size and current page; it does not authorize a fixed business page count.

acceptance_check.expected: hidden without horizontal overflow and available when actual horizontal overflow exists

remediation_actions.acceptance_criteria: Table horizontal scroll QA verifies chrome is hidden when all columns fit and becomes available under actual overflow with every existing header and row action reachable.
remediation_actions.decision: Hide table horizontal scroll chrome when there is no measured horizontal overflow while preserving horizontal access whenever the table exceeds its container.
remediation_actions.evidence_anchor: At frozen 1600x1000 all ten observed headers including Acciones are visible while horizontal scrollbar chrome remains rendered.

remediation_actions.implementation_change: Hide table_horizontal_scroll when scrollWidth <= clientWidth and retain overflow-x:auto so native horizontal access remains available when scrollWidth > clientWidth.
